## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasGroupBox> CreateGroupBox( const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, float w, float h, const std::string& title = "");
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasGroupBox> CreateGroupBox( const std::string& identifier, float w, float h, const std::string& title = "");
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasGroupBox> CreateGroupBox( const std::string& identifier, const std::string& title);
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasGroupBox(const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, float w, float h, const std::string& title = "");
UltraCanvasGroupBox(const std::string& identifier, float w, float h, const std::string& title = "");
explicit UltraCanvasGroupBox(const std::string& identifier, const std::string& title = "");
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Callbacks

Assign a lambda to the member (or call the setter). Capture the element and its parents **raw**, never as a `shared_ptr` - see [Events and callbacks](../Events-and-Callbacks.md#ownership).

| Callback | Signature | When it fires |
|---|---|---|
| `onCheckedChanged` | `std::function<void(bool)> onCheckedChanged` | arg: new checked state |
| `onCollapsedChanged` | `std::function<void(bool)> onCollapsedChanged` | arg: new collapsed state |
| `onCloseClicked` | `std::function<void()> onCloseClicked` | the close button was clicked |

**Inherited callbacks:**

- from [`UltraCanvasContainer`](UltraCanvasContainer.md): `SetScrollChangedCallback`, `SetChildAddedCallback`, `SetChildRemovedCallback`
- from [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md): `eventCallback`, `onPopupAboutToClose`, `onPopupClosed`, `onPopupOpened`, `SetEventCallback`

| `SetCollapsible` | `void SetCollapsible(bool collapsible)` | A collapsible group box draws a disclosure arrow before its caption; clicking the caption collapses the box down to just its title bar. |

## Option types in this header

### enum `GroupBoxTitleAlignment`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Left` |  |
| `Center` |  |
| `Right` |  |

### enum `GroupBoxFrameStyle`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Framed` | Classic fieldset: caption embedded in a gap in the top border line. |
| `Header` | Caption sits in a header strip above the content, full border + separator. |
| `Flat` | No border; caption strip on top of an (optionally) filled background. |

### enum `GroupBoxActivatorStyle`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Checkbox` | Square checkbox with a checkmark. |
| `Switch` | Sliding on/off switch (iOS-like pill). |

### enum `GroupBoxIndicatorSide`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Left` |  |
| `Right` |  |
